title: A Primitive Theory of Next-Gen General Intelligence Based on Global Mathematical Verification Closed-Loop
summary: Existing Transformer and large model theoretical systems uniformly adopt the ”prediction-first” paradigm, defining intelligence as ”fitting the data distribution of the real world and next-token prediction”. This theory overturns conventional understanding and proposes the unique primitive of intelligence: a continuous, multi-layered, global closed-loop for mathematical verification and checking. All artificial intelligence behaviors (fitting, reasoning, association, generation, generalization, error correction, cognition) are essentially mathematical comparison, constraint checking,…
